title: Chain events — 2026-11-17
body:
**Nvidia Q3 FY27 tonight, after the close** (16:20 ET / 22:20 CET; call 17:00 ET / 23:00 CET). First earnings without Jensen Huang — Colette Kress is interim CEO. Consensus ~$108.8–109.3B revenue (+~91% y/y), ~$2.47 adj EPS, gross-margin guide 74%; options price a ±9.7% move. Watch margin guidance and the 2027 capex commitments (OpenAI/Lambda deals).

Read-through: a beat keeps semis (NVDA, AVGO, ANET) and the power/utilities sleeve (CEG, DUK, XEL data-center load) bid; a miss or cautious capex talk hits infrastructure ordering and argues for holding the cash sleeve.

Also today: October retail sales 14:30 CET. Wed Nov 18: Anthropic IPO pricing (trades Thu Nov 19) — an AI-demand gauge for the complex.
